audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) early names 'W Sinister Steel' — that ability does not exist on current Katarina. (2) breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d tell you to 'hard CC during her resets', but Akshan's kit contains no crowd control at all.
audit.why: Katarina's W is Preparation: a move-speed burst that tosses a Dagger above her. Sinister Steel is a legacy name. And Akshan's P/Q/W/E/R carry no CC flag and no CC in Riot's text — advice to interrupt Death Lotus with hard CC is unactionable for this champion. Death Lotus is a channel at 550 range that also applies Grievous Wounds; the real answer is leaving the 550, which Heroic Swing at 800 does. All of Katarina's basic abilities cost 0 mana, so there is no resource window to wait for — only cooldowns: Q 11/10/9/8/7, W 15/14/13/12/11, E 12/11/10/9/8, R 75/60/45.
audit.corrected: Preparation named correctly; CC advice replaced with range advice; Death Lotus's channel, 550 range and Grievous Wounds stated; the zero-mana point added.

audit.why: Common Mistakes carries no rank language.

edits.before: Katarina's early combo relies on landing Q Bouncing Blade or getting close enough for W Sinister Steel, and if you hold max Q Avengerang poke range she has nothing safe to engage with. Use E Heroic Swing reactively to dodge her dagger throw rather than proactively — baiting it out is more valuable than saving it. Keep shoving to deny her any reset opportunities off cannon waves, since her whole kit revolves around chaining kills.
edits.after: Katarina's early combo needs a Bouncing Blade (Q) landed or a Preparation (W) dagger dropped on you, and none of it costs mana — so she can throw it every 11 seconds for free. Hold max Avengerang range at 850 and she has nothing safe to open with — Shunpo only reaches 725. Bait Heroic Swing out rather than banking it, and keep shoving: Voracity resets her whole kit off any kill anywhere on the map.

edits.before: Death Lotus turns any all-in from her into a real kill threat on you, especially once she gets daggers down around your position — this is her window to flip lane pressure.
edits.after: Death Lotus is a 550-range channel you cannot interrupt and it applies Grievous Wounds, so the answer is distance: Heroic Swing out of the 550 before the blades start.

edits.before: Track her ult (R) charge so you know when a dagger-reset all-in is live
edits.after: Count Death Lotus — 75s at rank 1, and you have no CC to break it

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Check it before every step-up. - E Heroic Swing is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — 725 range, 12s at rank 1, and free; step up only in that window. - Death Lotus is 75s at rank 1 and you have no CC to cut it — leave the 550 instead. - E Heroic Swing is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Her blink is 725 range and free, so she pays nothing to whiff it. Until Shunpo is spent, every commit of yours is a coin flip.

edits.before: Katarina wins by landing Shunpo, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Katarina wins by getting a dagger under you, Shunpo-ing onto it, and letting Voracity refund the whole combo.

notes: Two shipped defects here. First, the level chart disagreed with itself on all seven rows — phases[N].side said 'Skill' where win[N] said Akshan or Katarina. The packet levelChart matches win[] exactly, so I realigned phases[].side to it as one atomic group. Second, the page twice advised interrupting Katarina with hard CC; Akshan has no CC on any ability, so that advice could not be followed. Also killed 'W Sinister Steel', a legacy ability name that does not exist on current Katarina (her W is Preparation). The kit file flags Bouncing Blade with 'grounding' and 'zone'; Riot's own description mentions neither, so per the brief's rule I trusted the description and asserted nothing about grounding. Kit file also flags Preparation with 'knockup' — the description is a self-cast dagger toss with no displacement, so I ignored that flag too.
